newsitem.title: UK: RESEARCH ALERT - Kleinwort names more stocks for 97.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Kleinwort names more stocks for 97.

text.p: DFS Furniture Plc and Safeway Plc were included in Kleinwort Benson's list of stocks expected to outperform in 1997, dealers said on Tuesday, as the brokerage rolled out its favoured stocks for this year.
In a generally weak market, shares in DFS were up 9p at 618-1/2 by 0956 GMT while Safeway was unchanged at 396-1/2p.
Kleinwort strategist Phillip Isherwood said Kleinwort was positive on the outlook for retail stocks in general.
He said Safeway was favoured because it was trading at a discount to other supermarket operators and was in a position to exploit new technology developments.
DFS was seen as having a good retail format with room for expansion in a promising section of the market.

Kleinwort is releasing details of its ten favoured stocks for 1997 through this week. On Monday it named TT Group Plc and Johnson Matthey Plc, which on Tuesday extended Monday's gain to be up 17-1/2p at 588-1/2.
Kleinwort plans to release a further two from its list tomorrow.
